documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
Disclosures under Reg. 29(1) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported record financial performance for Q1 FY27, achieving quarterly volumes of 1.4 million units, revenue of INR 17,244 crore, and EBITDA of INR 3,596 crore with a margin of 20.9%. Performance was supported by broad-based growth across domestic motorcycles, exports, electric vehicles, and commercial vehicles despite raw material inflation and supply chain disruptions. The company's electric two-wheeler and three-wheeler portfolio generated double-digit EBITDA margins and reached 30% of domestic revenues. Looking forward, management is expanding total annual capacity from 7 million to 9 million units and executing a comprehensive portfolio refresh across its domestic motorcycle segments. Bajaj Auto reported record performance in FY26, with revenues exceeding INR 58,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR 12,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management aims to complete an exhaustive domestic motorcycle portfolio makeover within six weeks.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto is looking to increase export volumes beyond 250,000 units per month starting in Q2 FY27.
guidance.quote: we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its monthly exports to over 2,20,000 units in the current quarter.
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

guidance.claim: The company expects the motorcycle category growth to slow down to between 7% and 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects motorcycle growth to come almost entirely from the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments.
guidance.quote: But having said that, the great thing from our point of view is that we expect this growth to come almost entirely from the 125cc plus segment and even more so from the 150cc plus segment, which should grow at twice the industry rate.

guidance.claim: Management expects the domestic motorcycle industry to continue growing at 12% to 15% in the near term.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Bajaj Auto expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus motorcycle segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: The export business is on track to deliver its highest-ever top-line performance in USD terms during this financial year.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months. In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management expects growth rates in the 3-wheeler segment to sustain in the immediate future.
guidance.quote: Again, we expect these growth rates to sustain in the immediate future as driver adoption is responding to the healthy improvements in earnings and paybacks, both for ICE and electric.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across domestic and key international markets is very positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic motorcycle industry grew by 7% during Q1 FY27 as 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish.
demand_outlook.quote: The 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish, resulting in a motorcycle growth in the industry of 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: African export markets grew by almost 50% year-on-year, while Bajaj Auto grew at double that rate.
demand_outlook.quote: African markets did very well, growing by almost 50% and we grew by twice that rate.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to inflation, price increases, and LPG shortages.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers is expected to see continued or increased growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, the electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness not just continuity of growth, but perhaps a further increase in growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Following GST rationalization, the motorcycle industry grew by approximately 15% in Q3, with January sustaining at a similar pace.
demand_outlook.quote: But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry. And our understanding is that even January is sustaining at a similar level.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry growth in motorcycles is being driven by higher growth in the 125cc plus segment, and even faster growth in 150cc plus.
demand_outlook.quote: Equally important is the quality of growth with the 125cc plus segment growing at a faster rate and within that, the 150cc plus segment growing even faster.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric segment continues to propel the 3-wheeler industry, expanding at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

demand_outlook.claim: The Pro-Biking business delivered record domestic quarterly performance with KTM and Triumph combined volumes exceeding 35,000 units.
demand_outlook.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto is expanding its total annual capacity by almost 25% from 7 million to 9 million units.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has operationalized almost 90 joint KTM-Triumph outlets to expand reach.
capex_expansion.quote: The rollout of the joint KTM-Triumph stores to expand reach while ensuring store viability is progressing steadily with now almost 90 outlets operational.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's manufacturing capacity in Brazil has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Brazil. Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has established 80 operational joint KTM and Triumph showrooms.
capex_expansion.quote: The rollout of our joint KTM and Triumph showrooms has progressed swiftly with 80 such showrooms already operational.

capex_expansion.claim: Chetak's retail presence has expanded to over 850 cities with more than 500 exclusive stores.
capex_expansion.quote: The reach of Chetak today stands at 500-plus exclusive Chetak stores, combined with almost 3,000-plus motorcycle stores, which are shared with Chetak, and this presence has expanded to over 850 cities.

capex_expansion.claim: Annual capex was approximately INR 500 crores, divided equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested over INR 2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV.
capex_expansion.quote: We invested over INR2,300 crores between BACL and BAIH BV, the former to support the scaling of the lending book and the latter in furtherance of the KTM transaction.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto currently operates about 50 joint KTM-Triumph showrooms and plans to expand them to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

capex_expansion.claim: Effective November 18, Bajaj Auto's ownership in KTM Austria increased to 75%.
capex_expansion.quote: Effective November 18, Bajaj ownership in KTM Austria increased to 75% and a turnaround plan was commenced immediately, which has 3 main elements to it: number one, ensure liquidity.

capex_expansion.claim: Bajaj Auto invested slightly above INR 2,300 crores over a 9-month period into its Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA margin reached 20.9% in Q1 FY27, improving 10 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation accelerated through May, impacting quarterly revenue by approximately 4.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Through the quarter, commodity inflation intensified even further. Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: The company estimates a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Net cost inflation for the quarter came in at about 40 basis points after pricing actions.
margins_costs.quote: And therefore, net cost inflation came in at about 40 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Noble metals saw sharp price increases in the range of 20% to 25% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Within this, noble metals, rhodium, palladium and platinum saw particularly sharp moves, firming up in the range of between 20 - 25%, accompanied by broader inflation across copper, aluminium and lead as well.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA reached a record INR 3,161 crores with EBITDA margins expanding to 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was at INR3,161 crores, the highest in the company's history, growing 22% year-on-year. EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The company anticipated 50 to 60 basis points of material cost inflation impact at the start of Q4 and took pricing actions to cover half of it.
margins_costs.quote: At the start of the quarter, we had anticipated an impact of anywhere between 50 to 60 basis points for which we have taken certain pricing actions across the portfolio to offset about half this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: Bajaj Auto's EV business achieved double-digit EBITDA margin while unit economics improved.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: In Q3, the net price versus cost inflation hit reduced margins by nearly 50 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity constraints impacted model sales across both domestic and overseas markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity issues restricted sales of some models, both in India and overseas.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has reached a Chetak production capacity of 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's usable capacity in Brazil is around 50,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: And right now, like I said, our capacity is closer to 60,000, let's say, it's 50,000 usable.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volume grew 18% year-on-year in Q3 FY26, surpassing 600,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: The business grew at 18% year-on-year this quarter in volume terms and more in revenue terms.

orders_capacity.claim: The Chetak distribution footprint expanded to nearly 450 exclusive stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.
orders_capacity.quote: The scale-up was also supported by distribution network that expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.

orders_capacity.claim: Bajaj Auto maintains a 70% plus market share in ICE 3-wheelers and over 85% market share in CNG 3-wheelers.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 exceeded INR 2,300 crore, converting nearly 80% of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash on the balance sheet exceeded INR 21,000 crore at the end of June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the year with surplus funds exceeding INR 18,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR 8,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Free cash flow for the year was more than INR8,000 crores, a reflection of the very robust cash conversion on profit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's capital return will be split between a final dividend of INR 150 per share and a buyback of about INR 5,633 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto closed the quarter with a surplus cash balance of about INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated nearly INR 5,200 crores of free cash flow in the first 9 months of the financial year, a 70% increase year-on-year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: Bajaj Auto executed its last capital infusion into subsidiary BACL in October, amounting to about INR 300 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations faced raw material inflation, supply chain disruptions, logistics issues, and a ransomware attack during Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully.

risks_headwinds.claim: External supply disruptions led to an estimated volume production loss of 10% during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: While these disruptions did constrain our ability to fully service demand and resulted in some loss of production opportunities of about 10% of volume during the quarter, the business still delivered record volumes and financial performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industrial LPG supply curtailments created fuel availability challenges early in the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties and logistics issues impaired the company's ability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The E-Rick segment has slowed down due to street regulation enforcement.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though the E-Rick segment itself has slowed down due to enforcement of regulation on the streets, which is actually helping consolidate this industry in favour of the larger and better OEMs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recorded a one-time exceptional charge of INR 61 crores for past service gratuity cost following amendments under the new labor code.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of noble metals, aluminium, and copper are experiencing upward cost pressure, while steel remains stable.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble metals, including rhodium, platinum and palladium are further heating up. Aluminium and copper also remain on an upward trend, while steel seems to remain broadly stable at this point.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bajaj Auto absorbed the withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives in Electric 3-wheelers, which impacted margins by INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per vehicle.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to complete its domestic motorcycle portfolio makeover within six weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto plans to increase export monthly volumes beyond 250,000 units.
management_commitments.quote: we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company is expanding total capacity from 7 million to 9 million units per annum across businesses.
management_commitments.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The company will focus on gaining share in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments through Q1 and the rest of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Through Q1 and rest of FY27, the team will remain absolutely focused on the areas which I've highlighted earlier, gaining share in the 125cc plus segment, particularly in the 150cc plus segment riding the continued industry growth.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the results of the KTM turnaround plan to begin showing up in the latter part of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: I expect the results of this to start showing up in the latter part of 2026 itself.

management_commitments.claim: The company is looking to increase monthly exports to 2,20,000 units in the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to expand the joint KTM-Triumph showroom network to over 100 outlets by March.
management_commitments.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

management_commitments.claim: Bajaj Auto will launch over 8 product interventions in the Pulsar portfolio over the next 4 months.
management_commitments.quote: The waves of these interventions will be unrelenting here onwards with over 8 more such interventions being made in the next 4 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start scaling up the Riki product starting in quarter 1.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to start to scale up Riki beginning quarter 1.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
